Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Monday 3 and Tuesday 4 August, the 2147 Clapham Junction to Stratford train will not operate. Trains at 2203 and 2234 from Clapham Junction and at 2249 from Richmond terminate at Willesden Junction instead of Stratford.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: Monday 3 August, no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow (all terminals), Use METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge. Replacement buses operate.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Severe delays due to an earlier person ill on a train at Green Park. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, London Overground, Great Northern, Thameslink, Greater Anglia, South Western Railway and Southeastern services.
